name: Town of Simsbury
note: Address copied from the town's own calendar subscribe link. If the Actions log says robots.txt does not allow it, set enabled back to false.

name: Granby-Simsbury Chamber of Commerce
note: The Chamber's site (GrowthZone) lists about 90 events but I could not find a public calendar feed. In your browser, open an event page and look for 'Add to calendar' or 'Subscribe'. If it gives a link ending in .ics, paste it into url and set enabled to true.

name: Simsbury Historical Society
note: Checked: this is a hand-typed page, not a calendar, so there is no feed. Keep these events in MANUAL_EVENTS in data.js.

name: Simsbury Public Library
note: That site's robots.txt asked automated tools to stay out when I tried, so only enable this if the library publishes an official feed and the script's robots check passes.
